title: TIB-VA at SemEval-2022 Task 5: A Multimodal Architecture for the Detection and Classification of Misogynous Memes
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical architecture for a classification task (misogyny detection) in a shared task competition. While it deals with socially sensitive content (misogyny) and mentions religion as a target for hate speech, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or ethical/moral frameworks themselves.
